front.title: Source-IP-Community Filter for BGP Flow Specification

abstract.t: BGP Flow Specification (BGP-FS) propagates traffic Flow Specifications and Traffic Filtering Actions using BGP NLRI and BGP Extended Community encodings. This document specifies a new BGP-FS component type to support community-level filtering within a single administrative domain. The match condition filters traffic based on the BGP Community attributes associated with the route matching the packet's source IP address.
